title: db_err() error classification correctly maps constraint violations to Validation not Store
description: db_err() in lib.rs correctly partitions rusqlite errors: SQLITE_CONSTRAINT maps to KithError::Validation (surfaces as invalidArguments), all other errors to KithError::Store (surfaces as serverFail). This classification is correct per RFC 8620 and defensible: duplicate IDs and FK violations are client errors, I/O and corruption are server errors. The pattern is tested with independent oracles. Defend against suggestions to flatten all rusqlite errors to Store for simplicity.
